text: Le Rond Central, the Stade Brestois 29 sleeve sponsor, is the club's web shop, edited by the SAS KERMASPORT (SIREN 489019547, 69 rue Amiral Romain-Desfosses, Brest, capital EUR 475,700); its Président de SAS is the family holding KERHUPERT (SIREN 990088437, SARL), whose gérants are Geoffrey Julien Louis Hubert and Marie-Bénédicte Claire Hubert-Pons — the Hubert family. No state or sovereign-fund stake was found in the chain.
short: Le Rond Central is edited by Kermasport, chaired by the Hubert family holding Kerhupert.

source.name: Annuaire des entreprises (recherche-entreprises.api.gouv.fr), SIREN 489019547
source.note: Same response: nature juridique 5710 (SAS), siège 69 rue Amiral Romain-Desfosses, 29200 Brest. The registry response for KERHUPERT (990088437) lists HUBERT Geoffrey Julien Louis and HUBERT (PONS) Marie-Bénédicte Claire as gérants.
